title: 2026’s Biggest Fantasy Movie Revival Sets U.S. Release Date With New Trailer – Watch
content: One of the year’s biggest anime movies has been a revival of a classic franchise that had been dormant for over a decade, and now it’s finally set a release date for its launch in theaters across the United States.
author: ComicBook

title: New Avatar: The Last Airbender Prequel Series to Focus on Fan-Favorite Avatar’s Past
content: Avatar: The Last Airbender has expanded once more with the announcement of a brand new prequel series now in the works for Paramount+, and Avatar Studios promises it will be exploring the past of one of the timeline’s most mysterious Avatars.
author: ComicBook

title: New Mobile Suit Gundam Seed Movie Revival Confirms U.S. Release With Original Dub Cast – Watch Trailer
content: Mobile Suit Gundam is coming back to the big screen with a new revival of one of its most popular series, and the first look has been revealed with a new trailer gearing up for its launch next year. Mobile Suit Gundam SEED has been in the midst of a revival for the past few years.
author: ComicBook

title: Japanese Animation TV Ranking, September 21-27
content: The finale of a marathon re-airing of the 10th season of the live-action A Solitary Gourmet series aired on TV Tokyo on Monday, September 21 at 5:50 p.m., and it earned a 5.1% rating. A similar marathon re-airing of season 2 aired on TV Tokyo on Wednesday, September 23 at 5:50 p.m., and it earned a 4.7% rating.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Confirms New U.S. Streaming Platform Ahead of Premiere
content: Dragon Ball Super is set to finally make its highly anticipated return to screens this Fall, and the new remake series has confirmed another major streaming home where fans will be able to check it out.
author: ComicBook

title: Shonen Jump’s Smartest Anime to Return With New Sequel – Watch First Look Trailer
content: The smartest anime franchise to ever come out of the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has confirmed it’s coming back to screens with a new sequel anime with a first look revealed at what’s next.
author: ComicBook

title: Japanese Animation TV Ranking, September 14-20
content: A marathon re-airing of the 10th season of the live-action A Solitary Gourmet series aired on TV Tokyo on Tuesday, September 15 at 6:20 p.m., and it earned a 4.5% rating. The Fortune Favors Lady Nikuko anime film aired on NHK Educational on Sunday, September 20 at 3:30 p.m. and it earned a 0.8% rating.
author: ANN

title: New 'Dr. Stone' Anime Announced
content: The Stone Fes.2026 event at Yokohama Buntai announced on Saturday that a sequel anime subtitled Dr. Stone: Terraforming is in production. The official website also revealed a new anime logo (pictured above) and an announcement promo.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Millennium Family TV Anime Casts Taihi Kimura
content: The staff for the television anime of Sho Kasugai 's Millennium Family ( Odoru Sennen Kazoku ) manga announced on Saturday that Taihi Kimura voices Noel, the third son of the Benfield family. The anime will air on TBS and other stations.
author: ANN

title: Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING Sequel Anime Announced
content: A new Dr. STONE sequel anime titled Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING is officially in production. The project will continue the story after the conclusion of the TV anime , which premiered its series finale on June 25, 2026. The new anime will adapt “TERRAFORMING,” a sequel story included in Volume 27 of the original manga.
author: Anime Corner
